records.observation: Historical B0 auxiliary MAE 1.14585 m and 99.4002% above tolerance.
records.hypothesis: Possible wrong focal grid, PLY scale, frame, renderer depth semantics, reference or denominator.
records.impact: Current scientific interpretation of expected splat Z against first-surface depth. No confirmed deployment or training defect.
records.validation: Preregistered family selection and 770 region rows. All 32 acquisition chains, 1,008 Blender projections, native source references and 335 geometry checks.
records.conclusion: Raw discrepancy reproduced. Remaining evidence supports a scene-dependent model, rendering-construct or data-domain limitation. A unique upstream contribution has not been identified.

records.observation: Half-sized R1 source predictions had only original 512-grid geometric reference data.
records.hypothesis: Interpolated camera-Z would mix surfaces and sample the wrong rays.
records.confirmed_cause: Original R1 protocol retained reduced input RGB, source camera and predictions but did not require a native reduced-grid source truth.
records.impact: New diagnostic source comparisons only. Formal target grids remain 512 square.
records.validation: Reopened sealed Blender files, matched actual 256 camera matrices and validated native EXR Position, native PNG and reprojected landmarks.
records.conclusion: Four matched source comparisons are available.

records.observation: The prior private Chinese handoff described 419324 errors as all missed errors.
records.hypothesis: The handoff omitted errors assigned unknown.
records.confirmed_cause: The prose used LY alone while outside-high is LY + UY.
records.impact: Handoff, notes, release text and counts. No changes to scores, thresholds or labels.
records.validation: Independent raw V/E/S masks, 120 camera-method AP values, operating states and pooled counts.
records.conclusion: B0 HY 1608191, LY 419324, UY 15732. Outside-high errors 435056.

records.observation: The historical system release field could display Windows 10.
records.hypothesis: Kernel/compatibility fields may differ from the installed Windows product.
records.confirmed_cause: The previous handoff reused a raw platform field as a product name.
records.impact: Human-readable environment reporting. Raw receipts retain their original system fields.
records.validation: Direct product caption, registry display version, build and UBR on the Windows worker.

records.observation: The original source license referenced a file absent from the old ZIP. The only embedded expected example view was v01.
records.hypothesis: The original self-contained reference and parity scope were incomplete.
records.confirmed_cause: Old export inventory omitted docs/licenses.md and embedded a single reference view.
records.impact: Wheel, readable CPU source, standalone documentation, all six expected maps and new ZIP. Original trained weights and authored example remain reusable.
records.validation: Scope check, separate use notices, six-by-five clean CPU parity, internal manifest and independent external checksums.
records.conclusion: New candidate links resolve in the extracted ZIP and six numerical references are available.

records.observation: The Blender World can illuminate an empty camera ray while splats composite over black.
records.hypothesis: Open backgrounds or incorrect compositing might explain the closed-studio findings.
records.confirmed_cause: Background contracts diverge on an exposed World. The actual studio wall and floor geometrically cover the padded frame.
records.impact: Existing closed studio study supported. Extension to open backgrounds needs an explicit matched contract.
records.validation: Check actual opaque boxes and camera frusta for all 172 grids. Compare closed scene and open World with primary-camera World visibility on and off.
records.conclusion: Every B0 reference pixel hits geometry. The closed control gives zero RGB delta, exposed World changes from lit to black.

records.observation: The initial GPU control wrote sample arrays and then failed to encode its PLY metadata.
records.hypothesis: A NumPy integer in the reporter may be non-serializable.
records.confirmed_cause: Official PLY reader returned numpy.uint32 for the native resolution.
records.impact: Probe receipt only. Original scientific renderer, geometry, frozen expectations, tolerances and fitted model are identical.
records.validation: A scalar regression test plus a complete new native GPU run and independent CPU regrade.
records.conclusion: 335 of 335 checks passed on both hosts.

records.observation: Two local verification commands initially failed before producing a scientific measurement.
records.hypothesis: Worker-relative Python and grade output modes have distinct path contracts.
records.confirmed_cause: One launch supplied a relative interpreter and one supplied a directory where grade mode requires a new JSON file.
records.impact: Archive-check and regrade invocation only. All attempted IDs retained.
records.validation: Reran with recorder-resolved Python and a named JSON file, checked all declared hashes and thresholds.
records.conclusion: 296 original bundles verified and the successful Mac grade is pinned here.

records.observation: At the close of rc.2, the privately verified ZIP had no public Release or public-download acceptance.
records.hypothesis: Repository identity and per-asset terms were needed for public distribution.
records.confirmed_cause: The rc.2 build preceded the owner's repository and outbound licensing decisions.
records.impact: External publication and public-address retrieval only.
records.validation: Inspect the exact public repository, pre-release, per-asset terms, independently published ZIP checksum and clean CPU run from an unauthenticated download. The rc.2 receipts identify the earlier private acceptance.
records.conclusion: The owner authorized wany614/evidence-lens and chose Apache-2.0 for original code, configurations and independently licensable model parameters, and CC BY 4.0 for original documentation, example media and the licensable portions of released research records. Third-party assets retain their own terms.

records.observation: The first private RC allowed an editable project import to influence its build and did not require a nonempty finite comparison in every method and view.
records.hypothesis: A dirty Python import or an uninformative zero-finite comparison could pass part of the delivery checks.
records.confirmed_cause: The original tool pinned selected scripts and checked an aggregate of available maxima. Its real rc.1 payload nevertheless passed independent raw validation of all 90 cross-platform result groups.
records.impact: Build tooling, standalone grader, acceptance reporting, instructions, version and container. Inference functions, thresholds and trained parameters retain their frozen scientific identity.
records.validation: Poisoned editable working-tree and PYTHONPATH regression, fixture isolation, retained failure evidence, external ZIP and wheel hashes, and a new six-by-five smoke with a detached receipt for each exact artifact.
records.conclusion: The rc.2 builder imports project code from the nominated commit. The grader requires all 30 nonempty comparisons and checks all 12 maps. The detached release acceptance identifies the final three platform runs.
